provenance.protocol: fixed first 96 hash-sorted claim-document source pairs with ≥1 expert evidence annotation, all labels excluded from sorting
provenance.decision: max nonneutral minus neutral margin across top2, require positive margin

limitations: Published SciFact TRAIN subset is disjoint from earlier DEV retrieval/model attempt, labels generated by original external annotators
Source documents deliberately oracle-selected through published evidence links; not end-to-end retrieval
Science label correctness is annotated text-evidence consistency, not world truth
The model is generic natural language inference, not KMD DRS, and cannot prove scientific falsification
Selection uses only IDs and presence of annotated gold, not gold label; gold not used to tune prompt, sentence selection or thresholds
